description.en: Crassigyrinus scoticus: whole living environment prop. Nominal whole 1m artistic asset scale. Composite reconstruction: 2023 Porro Fig6 low broad skull, postcranial Herbst Hutchinson Fig14 axial proportions and extremely reduced limbs, never old tall narrow skull. Body depth, skin olive-umber colors, tail soft outline and mild curve, small feet/digit arrangement, pose and tooth simplification are artistic. No single complete fossil claim. Aquatic not terrestrial support stance.
